answer_1.quote: Recent work has tackled this data-to-text generation task ... we adopt a Cycle Training approach ... to build on past research in self-consistent data-to-text generation.
models: Cycle Training (forward F and reverse R models)
answer_1.outputs: Generated natural language texts verbalizing structured RDF triples

answer_2.quote: We assess each system/strategy with five widely used automatic metrics ... ROUGE, BLEU, METEOR, BertScore, PARENT.

answer_4.quote: We develop a new counting and ranking-based annotation schema, and use it to conduct human evaluation. ... we collected the error annotations (FE, HE, IM) from two domain experts and the fluency annotations from crowd-sourced workers via an annotation tool built on the Appen platform.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators increase counts for Factual Errors (FE), Hallucination Errors (HE), and Information Misses (IM) based on defined definitions; for Fluency Preference (FP) annotators rank generations by grammar, structure, and coherence.
